# Files

Search, read and delete the files you upload to knowledge bases.

**Library:** [Maitento](index.md#maitento), for apps. More in [Knowledge](../../../concepts/knowledge.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`FileDelete`](#filedelete) | Deletes a file from its knowledge base, with its text and its search passages. |
| [`FileGetText`](#filegettext) | Gets the text Maitento extracted from a file in a knowledge base. |
| [`FileSearch`](#filesearch) | Searches a knowledge base and returns the passages that best match a query, best first. |

### FileDelete

Deletes a file from its knowledge base, with its text and its search passages.

```c
void FileDelete(string fileId)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fileId` | `string` | The file's id. |

Searches stop finding it straight away. The file can be in any of the tenant's knowledge bases. Fails with `Invalid file ID format: <id>` for text that isn't an id, and `Not found` when there's no such file.

### FileGetText

Gets the text Maitento extracted from a file in a knowledge base.

```c
string FileGetText(guid fileId)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `fileId` | `guid` | The file's id. |

**Returns** `string`: The file's text.

This is the text the file was indexed from, such as the words of a Word document or a PDF, not the file's original bytes. The file can be in any of the tenant's knowledge bases. Fails with `Not found` when there's no such file.

### FileSearch

Searches a knowledge base and returns the passages that best match a query, best first.

```c
jsonArray FileSearch(string partitionId, string query)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `partitionId` | `string` | The knowledge base's id. |
| `query` | `string` | What to look for, in plain words, such as `how much holiday can I carry over`. |

**Returns** `jsonArray`: The passages, as a JSON array, each with `text` (the passage, cut to 1,000 characters), `score` (higher is better: it ranks the results, and isn't a percentage), and the file it came from: `id`, `name`, `contentType`, `size` and `type` (such as `Pdf` or `Markdown`).

The search combines meaning and keywords, so a passage can match without sharing a word with the query. It returns up to 25 passages, and always the closest it has, even when none of them answers the query. Several can come from the same file. A temporary knowledge base's files are never indexed, so searching one finds nothing.

The query is embedded with the knowledge base's embedding model and keys. The search is refused while the knowledge base's index is being rebuilt for a new model, after such a rebuild has failed, and when no key may embed for it; the error says which. Fails with `Invalid partition ID format: <id>` for text that isn't an id, and `Not found` when there's no such knowledge base.
